class.name: HEGoCookTimings
class.brief_description: Collects the per-phase timings of a [method HEGoNode3D.cook] call.
class.description: Usage: [method begin_phase] before a phase, [method end_phase] after it, and [method format_summary] once the cook is done. Phases are printed in the order they were recorded, so adding an output handler needs no change here.

method.name: elapsed_msec
method.description: Milliseconds elapsed since [param start_usec], as returned by [method Time.get_ticks_usec].

method.name: begin_phase
method.description: Marks the start of a phase.

method.name: end_phase
method.description: Records the time since the last [method begin_phase] under [param phase_name].

method.name: total_msec
method.description: Milliseconds since this object was created, i.e. since the cook started.

method.name: format_summary
method.description: Human readable summary of every recorded phase plus the cook total.
